correctness.rationale: The generator and row-stochastic factors are explicit. At a stationary sweep, conservation yields equal edge flux; the only extra pre-edge mass is predecessor flux when its edge is earlier. Solving and normalizing gives the stationary vector, and strict positive self/neighbor transitions give uniqueness. Exact TV follows from the two probability levels. A derivative proves the dimension-free hyperbolic-tangent maximum; realized cyclic ascent counts give sharpness. Averaging cyclic conjugates is circulant and doubly stochastic. More than 21,000 independent exact rational assertions replayed; they are not treated as an all-size proof.

value.rationale: Long-run invariant bias is a central numerical question for split Markov processes. This theorem completely classifies every permutation order on a natural nonreversible cycle, gives a sharp all-dimension error envelope, and proves a same-cost exact stationary correction by group averaging. It separates stationary accuracy from finite-time weak order and creates an analytical benchmark, going beyond a routine positivity check or table entry.
